title: Exploring literature
kind: 对话 · Li Ming 与 Jenny 线上聊文学体裁和读过的作品

timeline.text: Li Ming and Jenny are chatting online.
Hey, Li Ming. We’re learning about different types of literature in our English class this week. So far, we have read fables and fairy tales.
Oh, fables! I really enjoy them. They’re short but meaningful.
Exactly. I think fables are rich in morals. One of my favourites is The Fox and the Grapes. Have you heard of it?
Yes! It’s a good one. I also like science fiction. Have you ever read the novel Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea? I’m just a quarter of the way into it.
Yes, I love it. Jules G. Verne takes us on an exciting underwater adventure full of discoveries. Yesterday, I just finished reading The Gift of the Magi by O. Henry.
Ah, I am familiar with that short story too. In my Chinese class, we’re reading ancient Chinese poems by great poets like Li Bai and Du Fu.
They wrote hundreds of amazing poems.
That sounds fascinating! I remember Brian is interested in writing poems. Perhaps you could discuss poetry with him one day.
Really? I hope he enjoys Chinese poems and finds inspiration in them.
I bet he does! Literature has so much to offer, and it can open new worlds for us. Let’s continue learning and exploring its wonders together!
